source: initial iOS-OOM-safe wasm heap ceilings (model-derived, not yet a captured wasm floor)
notes: peakKiB/settledKiB are WebAssembly.Memory.buffer.byteLength high-water per scenario.
These ceilings assume the -16384 (16 MiB) cache_size bound from crates/storage/src/sql.rs; turso's wasm default was 100000 pages (~400 MiB), the iOS OOM root.

Native corroboration (crates/storage/tests/memory.rs --release, Rust heap only, page-cache arena is mmap/off-heap on native): boot 326 KiB net / 346 KiB peak, steady100 179 KiB net / 509 KiB peak, pull10k 211 KiB net / 3445 KiB peak, residency 500 vs 100 docs 217 vs 179 KiB (flat), reread-one-doc-500x 0 KiB.
Replace these ceilings only with three repeatable release-wasm chromium runs of the boot/steady100/pull10k scenarios that stay under them.
